record.dic_text:
06204 `Orpah {or-paw'}

源自 06203; 陰性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Orpah 2; 2

俄耳巴 = "瞪羚"
1) 摩押女子，拿俄米之子基連的妻子，也是路得的妯娌
record.edic_text:
06204 `Orpah {or-paw'}

from 06203;; n pr f

AV - Orpah 2; 2

Orpah = "gazelle"
1) a Moabite woman, wife of Chilion, the son of Naomi, and sister-in-
   law of Ruth
